entries.title: calcMDVfromSamp is called as calcMDVfromSamp(points, measuredMetabolites), every call stops with an error
entries.why: Lines 57-58 call calcMDVfromSamp(samp.points, measuredMetabolites) against its signature (glc, points, experiment): non-empty points reach convert_input (line 34 of calcMDVfromSamp), which exists nowhere in src, and experiment is never passed (line 32/36 need it), so every call errors.

entries.title: Every call with at least 200 samples stops with an error instead of returning the bins
entries.why: Line 21 sets output = 0 and line 142 does output.samps = samps, a field assignment on a double, so every call with >=200 samples errors after binning.

entries.title: IDsAdded keeps only the last accepted suggestion
entries.why: a is set to 1 on line 35 and never incremented, so lines 42-45 overwrite row 1 for each accepted suggestion; the documented 'list of added IDs' keeps only the last.

entries.title: A suggestion list with fewer rows than columns stops with an index error
entries.why: Line 37 loops to length(IDsSuggested) (max dimension = 6 columns for a 2-row list) and line 38 indexes IDsSuggested(i,6), so i=3 is out of bounds for a valid short list.

entries.title: The option annotationVerification has no effect
entries.why: annotationVerification is defaulted on lines 42-44 and never read; line 62 writes source:type:date only, so the documented optional input has no effect.

entries.title: An empty field receives NaN with a source when the table cell is NaN
entries.why: Line 59 parses as isempty(field) || (hasNaN(field) && ~isnan(cell)), so an empty field takes a NaN cell; line 60's text checks pass NaN and lines 61-62 write NaN plus a _source. The isnan(RAW{i,j}) clause shows the intent to skip NaN cells; borderline but wrong-result is defensible.

entries.title: The documented output IDAdded is not assigned when nothing is added, so a call requesting it stops
entries.why: IDAdded is assigned only inside the add branches (lines 64-66, 82-84, 96-98) and never initialised, so requesting the documented second output when nothing is added errors.

entries.title: The formula columns of the documented input format are dropped
entries.why: Lines 108-110 match headers only after replacing blanks; 'neutral_formula'/'charged_formula' (the documented example, line 14) are not substrings of any field2Add name (neutralFormula/chargedFormula), so the columns are silently dropped.

entries.title: A table without a name column stops on an undefined variable
entries.why: Line 64 concatenates the undefined variable metList; the doc (lines 12-16) requires the name column, so limitation is right.

entries.title: A field missing from the model is created with one entry per metabolite up to the last match only
entries.why: Line 79 creates a missing field as [] and lines 83/87/90 grow it with {hit} only up to the largest matched index; columnVector (line 132) does not pad, so a created field (e.g. metDrugbank from translateMetStr2COBRAmodel) is shorter than mets, contrary to the intent stated at line 77.

entries.title: A row whose VMH id is not in the structure overwrites the metabolite of the previous matched row
entries.why: When line 53 finds no match, line 54 skips the assignment and vmhId keeps the previous row's value, so the loop at line 58 writes the unmatched row into the previous metabolite. Real with the shipped table and any partial structure (the test's trigger substitutes the data file, but the path is the same).

entries.title: A table whose first row with a VMH id has no matching metabolite stops the function
entries.why: If the first row with a VMH id has no match, vmhId is never defined and line 58 errors; with the shipped table whose first id is absent from the structure this is a valid call that fails.

entries.title: A comma-separated VMH id that is not in the structure stops the function
entries.why: Line 47 indexes VMH2IDmappingAll{find(...),1} with an empty find for an id not in the structure, giving zero elements on the right-hand side of vmhId{j} =, which errors.

notes: Triggers of entries 1 and 3 replace the hard-coded xlsx (line 22); the behaviour follows from the code with the shipped table too.

entries.title: A KEGG, BioCyc or BiGG id is never found when its column has a blank cell
entries.why: Line 50 calls strmatch on RAW(:,col), which holds NaN for blank xlsx cells; this yields no match (or an error swallowed by the try at line 49), so KEGG/BioCyc/BiGG look-ups add nothing. That blank cells exist in the shipped table could not be checked by reading (no xlsx reader), but the code path is clear.

entries.title: The metabolite counter is printed for every identifier looked up
entries.why: Line 48 is a bare 'i' with no semicolon, so it prints once per non-empty identifier.

entries.title: A ChEBI cross-reference stops the processing of the answer
entries.why: cheBIId/Ce appears twice in mapping (lines 58 and 61), so strmatch at line 118 returns two indices, mapping{match,1} is a comma-list, the dynamic field reference at line 120 errors, and the try at line 92 (no catch) silently drops the remaining hits.

entries.title: A mismatch needs a field fullName and otherwise stops the processing of the answer
entries.why: Line 131 reads .fullName, which metaboliteStructureFieldNames does not define; the error is swallowed by the try at line 92, so IdsMismatch stays empty and later cross-references of that answer are lost.

entries.title: Numeric identifiers are never queried
entries.why: cleanUpMetabolite_structure makes pubChemId and chemspider numeric (str2double at its lines 63, 79), and regexprep at line 95 errors on numbers. The try at line 92 swallows this, so those identifiers are never queried.

entries.title: The progress shown exceeds 100 percent when startSearch is above 1
entries.why: Line 87 uses i/(endSearch-startSearch+1), so with startSearch>1 it exceeds 100%. Console text only.

entries.title: No uptake or no secretion exchange common to both conditions stops the call
entries.why: common_slope_upt/common_slope_secr are created only inside the loops at lines 63-70; with an empty intersection they are undefined at lines 81/101.

entries.title: An empty difference set is not assigned, so a call requesting it stops
entries.why: The eight outputs are assigned only inside the if branches (lines 84-111); an empty difference set leaves its output unassigned, so a call requesting it errors.

notes: Possibly unrecorded: lines 102-104 store slopeRatio<1 in cond2_secr_higher while their own comment says secretion is higher in cond1, and the change values are computed differently per branch (line 91 ratio-1, others x100). Worth a separate check of the uptake/secretion labelling.

entries.title: The documented essAA_excl flag and its default stop the call
entries.why: essAA_excl (documented 0/1, default 0 set at lines 45-47) is passed straight to ismember as the list of exchanges to remove (lines 89-90); ismember(cell, double) errors, and the documented essAA list is never built.

entries.title: Fewer than four exchanges stop the call with an index error
entries.why: Line 55 loops to length(input_A), the larger dimension, so a 3x4 matrix runs i=4 and line 57 indexes row 4. Inputs are documented as 4-column matrices with one row per exchange.

entries.title: More than two metabolite pairs stop the call with an index error
entries.why: Line 28 tests mets{p,1} while lines 29-31 and 44-50 treat column p as the pair (mets{1,p}, mets{2,p}), so a 2xN list with N>2 indexes a nonexistent row.

notes: performPPP (the producer) loops over rows (mets{p,1}, mets{p,2}), so the two functions also disagree on the layout of mets.

entries.title: Only the first two phenotypes are plotted
entries.why: Lines 32-39 compute x_i/y_i/z_i for every phenotype, but lines 60-64 plot only x1 and x2. The doc places no limit on the number of phenotypes, so a third is silently missing. Borderline (the author may have meant two), but the per-phenotype loop and the commented-out general loop show the intent.

entries.title: The coordinates of every phenotype are printed to the console
entries.why: The eval strings on lines 37-39 have no semicolon, so they print.

entries.title: The colour order is changed for every later figure of the session
entries.why: Line 46 sets the root DefaultAxesColorOrder, which persists after the call. This is a side effect, not a change to the output.

entries.title: An exchange list with fewer rows than columns stops the function
entries.why: Line 19 sizes the table with length(Ex_added_all_unique), its largest dimension (4 or 6 columns from statisticsAddedExchanges), so with fewer exchanges than columns line 20 hits a size mismatch.

entries.title: The table is not ordered by frequency as documented; the sorted copy goes to a differently spelled variable
entries.why: Lines 74 and 76 assign EX_added_all_unique (capital X) while the output is Ex_added_all_unique, so the documented frequency ordering is never applied.

entries.title: The sample counter is printed for every sample
entries.why: Line 32 is a bare 'i'.

entries.title: A rule enclosed in parentheses stops with an error
entries.why: Rules containing or/and are wrapped again (line 42), so '(g1 or g2)' leaves '(term_1)' after the first reduction; unit then has one element and line 83 reads unit(2), an index error. Parenthesised rules are normal in distributed models.

entries.title: reactionKO2term points into the term list before it is reordered
entries.why: reactionKO2term is set at lines 48/93 against the pre-reorder index x, and lines 103-115 then reorder term (internal terms first), so the map points to the wrong terms, contrary to the output doc. No caller in src reads reactionKO2term, so the impact is limited.

entries.title: A model without any gene rule stops with an error
entries.why: An all-empty grRules leaves term2 (and term) undefined at line 115. The doc allows any n x 1 grRules cell and nothing forbids all-empty, so by the rule this is a documented input that fails. It does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: k.mat and nSets.mat are not written
entries.why: k and nSets are required and validated (lines 121-126), but lines 136-147 never save them, although OUTPUTS lists k.mat and nSets.mat.

notes: Also cosmetic, not recorded: OUTPUTS names maxFluxes.mat, but line 141 writes maxFluxesW.mat.

entries.title: Every call stops with the error that not all inputs are given
entries.why: The signature has 7 inputs and line 76 errors if nargin < 8, so no call can pass; lines 129 (hard-coded uels) and 132 (undefined setType) would fail next.

entries.title: Every call stops with the error that not all inputs are given
entries.why: The signature has 5 inputs and line 58 errors if nargin < 6, so every call fails; lines 109 and 112 have the same hard-coded uels / undefined setType problems.

entries.title: Every call stops on the undefined variable nSets and leaves the current folder changed
entries.why: The input is named n_sets (line 1) but line 179 reads nSets, so it errors before wgdx; cd(current) at line 183 is skipped, leaving the caller in inputFolder.

entries.title: Lengthening a short lb, ub or c array overwrites its last value with 0
entries.why: Line 97 nowArray(end:nRxns) = 0 overwrites the last existing value; the identity arrays use end+1 (lines 108, 115), and the section comment says 'Lengthen'.

entries.title: Models with no positively scored metabolite pair stop with an undefined-function error
entries.why: Line 165 calls zeroes (a typo for zeros) in the branch reached when no score is positive after clipping at line 159.

entries.title: Names and identifiers are used as regular expressions without escaping
entries.why: Names and IDs are inserted unescaped into regexes (lines 84/86/113/126/151/169), so identical names containing ( ) [ ] + . do not match themselves, and the name criterion wrongly contributes nothing. An unbalanced bracket can even make regexpi error.

entries.title: A SEED identifier given as a cell stops the function
entries.why: A nested-cell SEED id is not a documented or produced format: verifyModelBorg builds metSEEDID as a cell of char (its line 272), and nothing defines cell-valued entries. The iscell handling at lines 145-147 covers KEGG only, so the SEED failure is an undocumented input.

notes: Quarantine rests on the regex-escaping entry.

entries.title: 'noSeed' score of a single-metabolite compared reaction uses the minimum over the template metabolites
entries.why: Line 81 min() of diffNumRxns(s1(:,ir1), s2(:,ir2)) works column-wise for 2+ compared metabolites but returns the global minimum for a 1-row selection, so single-metabolite reactions are scored inconsistently (the trigger arithmetic, 1 vs 3/7, checks out).

notes: The doc names the input seedMats but the code uses seedMets, 'noSeed' is undocumented, and mmatch stays all zeros in the noSeed path. Not recorded.

entries.title: A training list with exactly one matched reaction stops with an index error
entries.why: With one hit, hitPos is 1x2 (lines 61-62) and length(hitPos) = 2 (lines 63, 68, 74), so line 75 reads hitPos(2,1), out of bounds, before any optimizer branch.

entries.title: rxnID and metID entries are shifted when an entry has no ID of the model
entries.why: Lines 161/188 assign IDs{iRxn} to Model.rxnID{IDIndexes(iRxn)} instead of IDs{IDIndexes(iRxn)}, shifting IDs whenever an earlier entry has no match.

entries.title: rules and rxnGeneMat are never built
entries.why: rxnGeneMat is created all-zero at line 216 and line 219 tests its sum, so lines 220-242 (rules/rxnGeneMat construction, with the comment 'only make the rules if there are grRules') can never run. That is handling code never reached on a valid input, which the rule classes as wrong-result, not limitation. It does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: Data entries 1 and -1 cancel out and the organism is reported without experimental data
entries.why: Line 70 tests abs(sum(values)) > 0, so mixed 1/-1 entries cancel. The abs() shows the intent that negative-only data counts as data, so cancellation is unintended. Low impact: the header itself notes the shipped tables are unaffected.

entries.title: Spreadsheets with no unannotated reaction stop with an index error
entries.why: unannotatedRxns starts as {} (line 43); if nothing is unannotated, line 84's unannotatedRxns(:,1) on a 0x0 cell errors.

notes: Not recorded: the doc gives inputDataFolder a default that is never implemented, and lines 47/86 print i (cosmetic).

entries.title: A KBase reaction irreversible where the VMH reaction is reversible is not reported as similar
entries.why: Only reversible VMH formulas get extra variants (lines 80-87, still '<=>') and only reversible KBase formulas get '->' variants (lines 138-149), so an irreversible KBase vs reversible VMH pair never meets in the intersect at line 154. That contradicts the documented 'or vice versa'.

entries.title: files that are not SBML or .mat files are returned as model identifiers
entries.why: Line 27 applies any() over the whole contains() column, giving a scalar, so delInd is 1 or empty, not the per-file mask that the comment on line 26 intends.

entries.title: the distances are stored in comDistTmp but read from the undefined comDist
entries.why: Lines 38-41 store results in comDistTmp, but lines 52/54 read comDist, which is defined nowhere.

entries.title: the blocks of 100 rows run past the last strain
entries.why: The parfor at lines 38-39 runs k=j:j+99 regardless of size(data,1), so fewer than ~100 strains index past the last row (data(k,k+1:end) also takes a diagonal slice, not strain pairs).

entries.title: the header row of a numeric flux file is dropped by readtable
entries.why: Line 74 uses readtable(...,'ReadVariableNames',false), which on current MATLAB detects and skips the header line of a numeric file, so data(1,:) holds numbers and strrep at line 79 errors. Lines 93/102/119 use str2double, so the code expects text cells.

entries.title: the default metsToAnalyze analyses no metabolite
entries.why: With the default {} (line 30), setdiff at line 83 returns every column and line 84 deletes all metabolite columns, contrary to the documented default 'all computed metabolites'. Quarantining either way (unusable-option or wrong-result).

entries.title: the metabolite counter is printed
entries.why: Line 115 is a bare 'j'.

entries.title: 16 to 19 taxa with few singletons raise an index error
entries.why: With 16-19 taxa and few singletons, the else branch at line 160 takes uniqueXX(1:20), out of bounds.

entries.title: three t-SNE coordinates are stored in two columns
entries.why: Line 260 asks tsne for 3 dimensions but line 263 assigns into columns 3:4, a size mismatch.

entries.title: the custom-feature branch filters on the taxa of the last taxon level
entries.why: Lines 246-248 filter on taxa (left over from the taxon loop) instead of feats, so they do nothing. Lines 66-67 normally prevent 'N/A' features, so there is no observable effect on valid inputs, and cosmetic is acceptable.

notes: Also not recorded: perpl (used at line 260) is defined only inside the taxon loop when size(data,1)>10, so the custom-feature branch can hit an undefined variable.

entries.title: the percentage of reconstructions is divided by the count of the most common feature
entries.why: Lines 59/75 divide by max(B) (the most common feature), while the column header and the ylabel (line 92) promise a percentage/fraction of reconstructions.

entries.title: metabolite and uptake/secretion features are looked up in the reaction database
entries.why: This changes the written table: Description/Formula/Subsystem stay empty for every metabolite-presence and uptake/secretion feature (i=2,3 go through the reaction lookup at lines 51-56). The i==4 branch (line 69) shows that metabolite features are meant to be looked up in database.metabolites. It is not a documentation-only problem; mild, and it does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: the row range is built from size(getTax), a two-element vector
entries.why: 2:size(getTax)+1 uses the size vector as a colon operand (lines 49, 105), which errors on R2025a (per the recorded observation).

entries.title: the table of taxon level i is named with the file prefix of row i
entries.why: Line 91 indexes files{i,1} with the taxon index i=1..6 against 4 rows, an error at i=5 (Class); line 151 uses the feature index the same way.

entries.title: numeric presence values become NaN on R2020a and newer
entries.why: Line 55 applies str2double to cells that readInputTableForPipeline returns as numbers on R2020a+, giving NaN; line 112 has the version branch that line 55 lacks.

entries.title: undefined variable ddataByFeature
entries.why: Line 126 reads ddataByFeature, defined nowhere (typo for dataByFeature).

entries.title: Every comparison stops at a test function that does not exist in the toolbox
entries.why: Test_MassChargeBalance and the other Test_* functions called at lines 278-820 exist nowhere in the repository, so every comparison errors at line 278.

entries.title: Metabolite content is reported as identical whenever the reactions are identical
entries.why: Line 166 compares modelNew.rxns with modelPrevious.rxns in the metabolite section, so identical reactions report metabolites as unchanged.

entries.title: Aromatic amino acid results are reported as bile acids, bile acids as drugs, drugs are left out
entries.why: plotTestSuiteResults writes rows in the order Carbon, Fermentation, Putrefaction, Secretion, Uptake, AromaticAA, Bile, Drug, growsOnDefinedMedium (its lines 223-233); lines 85-96 label row 6 as bile acids and row 7 as drugs and never read row 8.

entries.title: growth on the defined medium is lost when the file holds only numbers
entries.why: readtable(...,'format','auto') at line 46 returns a numeric 0/1 column, and str2double of numeric cells at lines 68/268-269 gives NaN, so growth/no-growth counts are 0 and line 274 computes 0/0.

entries.title: the sensitivity column header loses its blank
entries.why: strcat removes the trailing blank of 'Sensitivity ' (line 120). Header text only.

entries.title: A log file name shorter than four characters stops the function
entries.why: Line 27 indexes logFile(end-3:end), which fails for names shorter than 4 characters.

notes: Not recorded: with exactly 3 inputs, itNum (lines 26, 28) is undefined, and the documented default GEMLog.txt is never used (with 2 inputs the output goes to the console).

entries.title: Template lines are written as fprintf formats, so a percent sign cuts the line
entries.why: Line 454 passes each template line as the fprintf format, so '%"' in template line 2315 ('max-height:10%">') truncates the output. Note that writeListItem relies on '\n' being interpreted, so the fix must keep that.

entries.title: The first template line is not written
entries.why: Line 30 reads line 1 and line 34 reads the next line before the first is stored, so '<!DOCTYPE html>' (template line 1) is never written.

entries.title: Every template line is printed twice to the console
entries.why: disp at lines 33/35 prints every template line twice.

entries.title: With exactly one metabolite without a formula, the wrong reactions are set to NaN
entries.why: With one missing formula, model.S(missingFormulaeBool,:) is 1xn and any() gives a scalar, so line 92 NaNs dE(1) instead of the reactions using that metabolite (the trigger arithmetic checks out).

entries.title: A count equal to 10^-dMax or smaller is dropped, so dMax = 0 drops every count of 1
entries.why: Line 52 keeps a count only if abs > 10^(-dMax), so dMax=0 drops every count of 1 and dMax=1 drops 0.1, although dMax is documented as a number of decimal places.
